description: Ground Penetrating Radar (GPR) Data - Old Bar Beach Survey is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Geoscience Australia Data. This record contains processed and topographically corrected Ground Penetrating Radar (GPR) data (. segy,. bmps) and summary shapefile collected on fieldwork at Old Bar Beach, NSW for the Bushfire and Natural Hazards CRC Project, Resilience to Clustered Disaster Events on the Coast - Storm Surge. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Geoscience Australia Data. Its tags are Earth Sciences, GPR, NSW, Published_External, coasts. It offers 6 resource(s) in html, pdf, zip. The portal shows 2025-10-17 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
